Name: Smartphone - AliveSmartphone
Author: NeNekoKun824
Description:
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest compatible versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher, Smartphone, and AliveNpcs.[/*]
[*]Optionally install Smartphone App Messenger, Smartphone App Stardew Social, and Generic Mod Config Menu to enable their respective integrations.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code][bridge] AliveSmartphone[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]This mod is an integration bridge and does not add a standalone smartphone app. The corresponding Smartphone apps must be installed separately.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
AliveSmartphone connects Smartphone interactions with the AI-powered dialogue, personality, memory, gossip, and story systems from AliveNpcs.
[list]
[*]Phone calls use AliveNpcs-generated dialogue instead of standard Smartphone dialogue.[/*]
[*]NPCs understand that calls are remote conversations and respond using natural, voice-focused phone dialogue.[/*]
[*]App Messenger replies can use the same NPC personalities as AliveNpcs, including custom personality overrides.[/*]
[*]Face-to-face conversations, phone calls, and Messenger chats can share same-day context.[/*]
[*]Messenger conversations can become village gossip, while existing gossip can influence future messages.[/*]
[*]A per-NPC secret-chat button prevents selected Messenger conversations from becoming gossip.[/*]
[*]Talk-only AliveNpcs story objectives can be completed through Messenger.[/*]
[*]Stardew Social posts and comments can contribute to AliveNpcs gossip.[/*]
[*]Village gossip can influence future Stardew Social posts and comments.[/*]
[*]Active AliveNpcs Experimental Content modes can also affect Messenger conversations and Stardew Social content.[/*]
[*]Most features can be enabled, disabled, or customized through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Optional integrations are automatically skipped when their corresponding apps are not installed.[/*]
[*]During events, festivals, and cutscenes, phone calls fall back to the original Smartphone behavior to avoid interfering with scripted scenes.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
Required:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Smartphone[/*]
[*]AliveNpcs[/*]
[/list]Optional integrations:
[list]
[*]Smartphone App Messenger — enables AI personalities, shared context, gossip, secret chats, and story-objective support in text conversations.[/*]
[*]Smartphone App Stardew Social — enables personality, gossip, and Experimental Content integration for posts and comments.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — provides an in-game configuration interface.[/*]
[/list]
